changeSet.author: DM
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW student_view AS SELECT u.id AS user_id, gi.course_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, COALESCE(SUM(gi.grade)::numeric, 0) AS total_points FROM grade_item gi JOIN "user" u ON gi.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, gi.course_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email;
